description: This is a cube-shaped ottoman, meticulously upholstered with a deep red, possibly faux leather, material. The design features classic tufting, where the fabric is pulled inward at regular intervals, creating diamond-shaped sections and distinct folds. Buttons, or indentations resembling them, are visible at each pulled point, enhancing the luxurious, capitonne style. The material has a subtle sheen, suggesting a smooth, somewhat glossy texture. It is a standalone piece, designed for both aesthetic appeal and practical use as a seat or footrest.
